SECRET SCAN UNVERIFIABLE: every commit printed "[secret-scan] gitleaks not installed - secret scan SKIPPED". Not clean, not bypassed; land runs the built-in scan. FOR A HUMAN REVIEWER, repo law: DW-203, DW-206 and DW-213 touch relay verification, signing secrets and the encrypted event payload. None was built and no key moved. Nothing built this cycle touches credentials, the vault or key storage. REACHABILITY checked before accepting: every built surface is mounted by TriggersPage and in the shipped sidebar. PendingTriggerApprovals is also mounted by TriggerConfig. DW-210 fell on this check (devOnly). DW-204 and DW-208 do not depend on any unmounted path. Not clicked in the running app, as uat.persona_pass says. DW-215 and DW-211 banners carry the raw rejection through inlineErrorCopy with no title, because no relay-named or catalog-named string exists and en.json is held: plainer than CloudWebhooksTab. Worth a string when it frees. DW-212 uses DataGrid's own error and onRetry props instead of a new banner, so the message is could_not_load_history alone; the reason goes to silentCatch. QA's design note said InlineErrorBanner; DataGrid.tsx:96 is the existing primitive for this. QA corrected its spec for it (35f43c5cb9): a captured banner node went stale when the first row landed. QA also fixed its own census rise (528b5d94b9, feed-item-ordered-by-the-renderers-clock on a test fixture). The builder edited no spec. DW-208 partial: its card also says a failed read should say so. With no new strings, the panel only drops the false "no listener" sentence, so a person sees Listeners (0) with nothing beside it. The 500 row bound stands for both reads and can still undercount; the guide says so. test_listeners_disabled reads "Subscription disabled" on a disabled trigger row too. DW-204 partial: the Test tab's custom event input and two selector labels are not covered by the spec or the build. All four Local Relay fields and the payload box are. DW-200: event-routing.md is historical, so only its line 3 pointer changed; its body still cites engine/background.rs under its own stale-citations note. Other guides under docs/features/plugins still link docs/plans/dev-findings-loop.md and pumper-inbuilt-feasibility.md: outside this card. The two pruned design links with no successor were dropped, not repointed. DW-123 and DW-200 reach further than their cards counted: 11 lines and 3 extra lines. DW-199: if DW-205 ships enforcement, that row must change back. While rerunning the build pipeline I typed `pkill -f vitest`, too broad for a machine with sibling sessions. It killed nothing: this shell has no pkill binary (only a wrapper function; /usr/bin/pkill is absent) and the error was silenced. A pipeline I had stopped with TaskStop kept running and ended on its own at the DW-211 gate beside the rerun; it committed nothing and only shared the output file. personas-web marketing guides not touched (out of this repo); the doc-sync law may owe one for these flows. Personas is commit-only: nothing pushed, master untouched.

skill_issues.where: references/cycle.md section 4 (QA first, one spec commit per item) and item_gates
skill_issues.what: Committing every item's specs before any build makes verify:affected red for one card on another card's spec when two cards share a component, and the rule has no state for it.
skill_issues.evidence: C:/Users/kazda/.temper/runs/c6/DW-211.verify.out: 4 of 58 red, all SmeeRelayTab.fieldNames (DW-204); DW-208.verify.out: 3 of 91, testTabFieldNames.
skill_issues.fix: Say so in cycle.md: build cards that share a file as one batch, or let the gate be read with the named not-yet-built specs excluded, recorded as such.

skill_issues.what: QA is not told to run the repo's census or gate on its spec, and a test fixture can raise a ratchet. The builder then meets a red gate on a file it may not edit.
skill_issues.evidence: DW-209 gate: census feed-item-ordered-by-the-renderers-clock introduced by LiveStreamTab.backfillFailure.test.tsx:32, fixed in 528b5d94b9.
skill_issues.fix: Add the repo's item gate over the spec files to the QA step, and say that a builder who finds a spec fault messages QA rather than editing it.

skill_issues.what: Triage asks for the falsifier and the quoted evidence, not reachability. Only the launch message asked whether the code is mounted, and a mounted surface can still be gated from shipped users.
skill_issues.evidence: DW-210: CloudWebhooksTab is mounted by TriggersPage.tsx:157 yet devOnly at sidebarData.ts:123. Cycle 3 built on dead ReviewFocusFlow.
skill_issues.fix: Make it a triage step: find the importer chain and any devOnly or tier gate on the card's surface.

skill_issues.where: tools/temper-scan.mjs and the runner block registered_paths
skill_issues.what: A scan focused on a frontend area files cards whose fix sits outside registered_paths, because the scan does not know the bounds. Five of 19 cards here, and the highest-impact ones, were real but unbuildable.
skill_issues.evidence: DW-203, DW-205, DW-206, DW-213, DW-214 all need src-tauri.
skill_issues.fix: Pass registered_paths to the scan so such cards are marked, or have the director widen paths to the area's backend when it wants them built.

skill_issues.where: references/cycle.md section 2, the scan cost table
skill_issues.what: The table says a focused personas scan runs up to 15 minutes and $5.37; this one ran longer and dearer.
skill_issues.evidence: ~/.temper/scans.jsonl row 2026-11-06T18:20:22Z: minutes 18, cost_usd 6.8111, focused.

skill_issues.what: The brief says run in the background and watch, but a foreground Bash call over about 3 minutes is moved to the background, so a runner waits through repeated poll calls.
skill_issues.evidence: This cycle: about 15 until-loop poll calls for the scan, QA and the gates.
skill_issues.fix: Name one waiting pattern in the brief, such as Monitor with an until-loop, and whether a runner may end its turn while a background task runs.
